# Aim

This notebook determines whether each model--language cell is sufficiently
complete and comparable for the substantive analyses. It reports corpus
coverage, fallback filtering, contrast sizes, and feature availability. It
does not test sublanguage alignment.

```{r dq-setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 9,
  fig.height = 5
)

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(stringr)

source(file.path("analysis", "helpers.R"))

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 12))
options(dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE)
```

```{r dq-configuration}
paths <- analysis_paths()
result_root <- paths$univariate_results

real_results_dir <- Sys.getenv(
  "ANALYSIS_REAL_RESULTS_DIR",
  unset = file.path(result_root, "real")
)

expected_items_per_model_language <- as.integer(Sys.getenv(
  "EXPECTED_ITEMS_PER_MODEL_LANGUAGE",
  unset = "30000"
))

expected_languages <- c(
  "de", "en", "es", "fr", "it", "nl", "pl", "ro", "sv"
)

primary_contrast <- "real_general_vs_biomedical"
```

# Load quality-control artifacts

```{r dq-load}
quality_files <- c(
  "model_registry",
  "fallback_filter_summary",
  "contrast_counts",
  "scoring_input_summary",
  "bad_lang_feat",
  "feats_ok",
  "postprocessing_complete"
)

quality_bundle <- load_analysis_results(
  result_root = result_root,
  files = quality_files,
  real_results_dir = real_results_dir
)

model_registry <- quality_bundle$primary$model_registry
fallback_filter_summary <- quality_bundle$primary$fallback_filter_summary
contrast_counts <- quality_bundle$primary$contrast_counts
scoring_input_summary <- quality_bundle$primary$scoring_input_summary
bad_lang_feat <- quality_bundle$primary$bad_lang_feat
feats_ok <- quality_bundle$primary$feats_ok
completion_status <- quality_bundle$primary$postprocessing_complete
```

# Run coverage

```{r dq-run-coverage}
run_coverage <- quality_bundle$index |>
  transmute(
    analysis_model,
    contrast,
    result_available = has_scores,
    completion_marker = has_completion_marker,
    stable_results_available = has_stable_results
  ) |>
  arrange(contrast, analysis_model)

run_coverage
```

```{r dq-model-inventory}
model_inventory <- model_registry |>
  filter(contrast == primary_contrast) |>
  select(
    any_of(c(
      "model_id", "model_label", "feature_family", "n_languages", "languages"
    ))
  ) |>
  distinct() |>
  arrange(model_id)

model_inventory
```

# Corpus filtering

```{r dq-fallback}
expected_total_per_model <-
  expected_items_per_model_language * length(expected_languages)

fallback_by_model <- fallback_filter_summary |>
  filter(contrast == primary_contrast) |>
  group_by(analysis_model, model_id, model_label) |>
  summarise(
    n_kept = sum(n_kept, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    n_expected = expected_total_per_model,
    n_removed_or_missing = pmax(n_expected - n_kept, 0),
    prop_removed_or_missing = safe_ratio(
      n_removed_or_missing,
      n_expected
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(prop_removed_or_missing))


fallback_by_model <- fallback_by_model %>%
  mutate(condition = case_when(str_detect(model_label, "completion") ~ "completion",
                               str_detect(model_label, "prompt") ~ "prompt",
                               .default = model_label))

fallback_by_model

fallback_by_model %>%
  filter(condition == "completion")
```

```{r dq-fallback-plot}
ggplot(
  fallback_by_model,
  aes(
    x = prop_removed_or_missing,
    y = fct_reorder(model_label, prop_removed_or_missing)
  )
) +
  geom_col(fill = "#4472C4") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  labs(
    x = "Removed or missing outputs",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Output loss before linguistic analysis"
  )
```

# Contrast sizes

```{r dq-cell-sizes}
cell_sizes <- contrast_counts |>
  filter(contrast == primary_contrast) |>
  mutate(
    domain = as.character(domain),
    comparison_group = case_when(
      domain == "general" ~ "reference",
      domain == "biomedical" ~ "target",
      TRUE ~ domain
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(
    analysis_model,
    model_id,
    model_label,
    language,
    comparison_group
  ) |>
  summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = comparison_group,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  )

cell_sizes <- add_missing_columns(
  cell_sizes,
  c("reference", "target"),
  value = 0
) |>
  mutate(
    smallest_cell = pmin(reference, target),
    largest_cell = pmax(reference, target),
    max_to_min_ratio = safe_ratio(largest_cell, smallest_cell)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(max_to_min_ratio))

cell_sizes
```

# Feature availability

```{r dq-feature-availability}
feature_availability <- feats_ok |>
  filter(contrast == primary_contrast) |>
  count(
    analysis_model,
    model_id,
    language,
    name = "n_features_retained"
  ) |>
  full_join(
    bad_lang_feat |>
      filter(contrast == primary_contrast) |>
      count(
        analysis_model,
        model_id,
        language,
        name = "n_features_removed"
      ),
    by = c(
      "analysis_model", "model_id", "language"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    across(
      c(n_features_retained, n_features_removed),
      ~ replace_na(.x, 0L)
    ),
    n_features_considered =
      n_features_retained + n_features_removed,
    prop_features_removed = safe_ratio(
      n_features_removed,
      n_features_considered
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(prop_features_removed))

feature_availability
```

# Analysis eligibility

```{r dq-eligibility}
model_quality_summary <- cell_sizes |>
  group_by(analysis_model, model_id, model_label) |>
  summarise(
    n_languages_observed = n_distinct(language),
    minimum_reference_n = min(reference),
    minimum_target_n = min(target),
    maximum_imbalance_ratio = max(max_to_min_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    fallback_by_model |>
      select(
        analysis_model,
        model_id,
        prop_removed_or_missing
      ),
    by = c("analysis_model", "model_id")
  ) |>
  left_join(
    feature_availability |>
      group_by(analysis_model, model_id) |>
      summarise(
        maximum_feature_loss =
          max(prop_features_removed, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = c("analysis_model", "model_id")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    complete_language_inventory =
      n_languages_observed == length(expected_languages),
    eligible_for_analysis =
      complete_language_inventory &
        minimum_reference_n > 0 &
        minimum_target_n > 0
  ) |>
  arrange(eligible_for_analysis, desc(maximum_imbalance_ratio))

model_quality_summary
```
